FN-JPAKRNF-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 401
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Phillip Rigsby
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/29/2025
House Bill 401 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Insurance by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of any additional personnel hired to
administer the provisions of this bill regarding the regulation of dental insurance.
